beats: I wanted to learn Norwegian by ear on the bus, but every app made me pick from ready-made lessons.
I couldn't just say the word I needed, upload a textbook page, or snap a photo of a menu.
Now a Cloudflare Worker turns any word, PDF, or photo into a narrated lesson.
Less like borrowing someone's tapes, more like recording your own.
Playback now starts in about a minute, not after the whole lesson renders.
